name: Horagolla National Park
description: Horagolla National Park, nestled in the Western Province, offers lush landscapes, diverse wildlife, and serene hiking trails. This protected area is perfect for nature enthusiasts seeking a peaceful escape from the hustle of daily life.
ticket_price: LKR 500-1000 approx small park entry; confirm at entrance

name: Yagoda Tea Garden
description: Yagoda Tea Garden is a serene estate nestled in the lush Western Province, known for its meticulously cultivated tea plants and traditional Sri Lankan architecture. Visitors can explore the tranquil gardens, learn about tea cultivation, and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding countryside.
activities: Tea plantation tour, scenic walk, tea tasting

name: Nittambuwa Spice Farm
description: Nittambuwa Spice Farm is a serene tea estate nestled in the Gampaha district, Western Province. Known for its lush green tea gardens and traditional Sri Lankan culture, it offers visitors a glimpse into the island’s agricultural heritage and natural beauty.
activities: Explore tea plantations, Learn about traditional farming practices, Visit the local village

name: Gampaha Herb Trail
description: Discover the Gampaha Herb Trail, a serene tea estate where ancient tea plants whisper secrets of the Western Province's rich agricultural heritage. Nestled amidst lush greenery, this trail offers a glimpse into the traditional practices that have shaped Sri Lanka’s tea industry.
activities: Explore tea plantations, Learn about tea-making techniques, Picnic in the scenic surroundings

name: Biyagama Botanics
description: Biyagama Botanics, nestled amidst lush tea plantations, offers visitors a serene escape with its tranquil gardens and historical significance. This estate stands as a testament to the rich cultural heritage and agricultural traditions of Western Province, Sri Lanka.
activities: Tea plantation tour, bird watching, photography

name: Kelaniya Spice Walk
description: Discover the rich cultural tapestry of Kelaniya Spice Walk, a serene tea estate where ancient traditions blend harmoniously with modern hospitality. Nestled in Gampaha, this picturesque site offers a glimpse into Sri Lanka’s agricultural heritage, showcasing the meticulous craftsmanship and vibrant colors of its spice gardens and tea plantations.
activities: Explore the tea plantation and spice garden, Learn about traditional farming practices, Visit the local tea factory

name: Ja-Ela Garden
description: Ja-Ela Garden, nestled amidst lush tea plantations, offers visitors a serene escape with its tranquil gardens and historical significance. This estate, known for its meticulous craftsmanship and beautiful landscapes, attracts nature lovers and tea enthusiasts alike.
activities: Explore the tea plantation trails, Visit the historic house, Enjoy local tea tasting
